the use of electronic communication in the context of pharmacy education in Iraq.
the extent to which the TAM is applicable to the use of Facebook and university email by Iraqi pharmacy faculty and students.

the TAM is an appropriate model to use for examining electronic communication modes among faculty and students.

both students and faculty are satisfied with using Facebook for academic purposes.
